literal: A day, showing itself like a mere unit of time, is actually a saw that cuts away life, if there are those who understand it.
translation: To those who have the wisdom to understand, a day is a saw that, while appearing to be just a measure of time, continuously cuts away at their life.
modern: நாள் என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஒரு எளிய கால அளவு போலத் தன்னைக் காட்டி, உயிரை அறுத்துக் கொண்டிருக்கும் வாள் ஆகும் அது, அதனை ஆராய்ந்து உணர்வாரைப் பெற்றால்.
explanation: This couplet uses a powerful metaphor to illustrate the impermanence of life. To an ordinary person, a day seems like a harmless unit of time passing by. However, to those who possess deep understanding, each passing day is actually a saw ('வாள்') that is steadily cutting away ('ஈரும்') at their lifespan ('உயிர்'). The word 'ஈரும்' specifically refers to the action of sawing or slicing, emphasizing the gradual but relentless reduction of our remaining time on earth.
